properties.digitization_method: ADDED 2026-09-18 for Mission Bay's North-blocks pass: real OSM building footprint. Arterra, 300 Berry St -- ~275-unit condo tower, developer Intracorp SF, architect Kwan Henmi, built 2009. 2026-09-29 accuracy audit: (1) The cited SocketSite post (2006-04-26) gives 268 units, not ~275; nothing cited gives 275, so read the unit count as 268 per that post. (2) The 2009 built year is supported by the DataSF Assessor roll: the per-unit condominium lots at 300 Berry St (e.g. parcel 8704012) carry year_property_built 2009; the 2006 post itself gives no completion year and OSM has no start_date.
properties.accuracy_caveat: REAL -- surveyed OpenStreetMap building footprint(s), not a hand trace or plan estimate. The underlying Assessor parcel is condo-mapped across many individually owned per-unit lots (confirmed against data/raw/parcels.geojson), so no single blklot represents the whole building and it cannot be joined via status.csv the way a single-owner parcel can. Using the real building footprint from OSM instead of a fabricated or arbitrarily chosen 'representative' unit lot, the same pattern already used for Mission Bay's other condo-mapped residential towers (Avalon I, Madrone and Radiance, re-checked against data/raw/parcels.geojson in the 2026-09 audit; Avalon II and III are not condo-mapped, and Arden and One Mission Bay were not re-checked).
